Package org.apache.juneau.commons.utils

Class CopyUtils

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.CopyUtils
Direct Known Subclasses:
OpenApiCopyUtils, SwaggerCopyUtils
public class CopyUtils extends Object
Utility methods for making copies and clones of collections, maps, arrays, and cloneable objects.

This class is the canonical home for the copyOf(...) family (collection/map/array defensive copies) and cloneOf(Object) (reflective null-safe clone). It is intentionally subclassable (via a protected constructor) so that per-module utility classes can add domain-specific copyOf(<BeanType>) overloads that coexist with the inherited collection overloads via ordinary Java overload resolution. A single static-import-on-demand of such a subclass brings in both the inherited collection overloads and the module's bean overloads.

    • cloneOf

      public static <T> T cloneOf(T value)
      Null-safe clone of an object via its public clone() method.

      Invokes the object's clone() method reflectively (since Object.clone() is protected and Cloneable declares no clone() method, a generic caller cannot invoke it directly), returning the result typed as the input.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The object type.
      Parameters:
      value - The value to clone. Can be null.
      Returns:
      A clone of the value, or null if the value was null.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the value's runtime type does not expose a public clone() method, or the clone failed.
